title: Complete engine/runtime owner and historical blanket-claim reconciliation
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: complete engine/runtime palette; qualify chronology, authority and measured scope without deleting ideas
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full1844-line owner review covers RT1–RT10, PF1–PF8, DA1–DA7, TS1–TS17, CH1–CH7, OS1–OS12, EG0–EG7, LB1–LB11, AI1–AI7, MC1–MC38, OE1–OE10, XE, SB1–SB10, ECX1–ECX35, OV1–OV8, IM1–IM9, CE1–CE15, AB1–AB16, GT1–GT4, ER1–ER18, DS1–DS11, EL1–EL52, A1–A7 and later D2/reconciliation rounds. All are retained in place. The early stack/size/import/timer/storage and no-replay inventory is October14 source inspection, not current measurements. Later named streams, headless runner, domain registration and Electron deliveries supersede selected absence claims. File/test/line counts identify snapshots, not implementation progress.

F2: Current AD39 selects Electron plus web. TS6/EG5's early blanket no-quota/no-throttling/Steam claims are qualified by ER3/ER10 and the actual host deliveries: native files differ from web storage; sleep/exit can stop execution; Steam API, Cloud, packaging and release remain separate work. DS3's early Chromium evidence-carries-over phrasing is narrowed by the delivered first-slice note that Electron differs from system Chrome and needs its own host checks. Version pins, package sizes, current-window state, browser compatibility, shell anecdotes and distribution requirements are dated, not freshly verified. The first shell smoke did not exercise the native Save dialog, minimized rate or other OS packages.

F3: Preserve host chronology. EL18 frozen snapshots separate current/adopted from latest build, keeping the app origin/save and preventing an unrequested reload. EL46's heartbeat crash/hang recovery retains the last successful save, not unsaved progress; the tested late main-process stall/sleep reset differs from an unresponsive renderer. A1 is a mirror of whole localStorage plus compressed history, not replacement of the game's authoritative writer or all browser data with native storage. Close has a bounded1.5-second save attempt, not guaranteed flush on a hung page. A3 pop-out is read-only and never boots a second game. A4 attention seams were tested without a genuine available lead; menu/window memory and live-save restore retain their listed gaps. A5 loaded the local font with requests blocked, but the hidden zero-width element did not prove visible glyph appearance. Tests and six hidden host checks are attributed historical evidence, not current installed-profile acceptance.

F4: The later on-screen stop overrides earlier INACTIVE/watchable test suggestions: agents use hidden Electron/headless browsers and never open a visible window during this work. Hidden still consumes CPU/memory; it is not a battery measurement. The current GAME_MCP_LIMITS owner records a registered game MCP and later compact/session/checkout/freeze/quote/screenshot capabilities, superseding the original not-registered/eight-tool/no-screenshot snapshot and SDK/CDP-first proposal. Headless text and a saved-state Electron screenshot mirror are distinct surfaces; the mirror cannot certify the headless layout or transient selection. Old localhost ports, userData switches, preview status, worker prompts and GT commit/push/worktree recipes are historical execution notes, not present authority. AD41 keeps the primary checkout default; no new worktree, worker, client registration or launch follows here.

F5: One authority per fact (AR3) does not require one scalar clock for all worlds, observers, leases, wall labels and causal elapsed time. Keep the early RT/SB/OV/AB clock shorthand qualified by the later keep-separate list and selected consumer. Split versus bulk equality compares the same admitted time, unspent remainder, dependency boundaries and actual per-system policy; observation-based local-life attempts intentionally differ. A worker or monotonic timer cannot select away-time rewards. Runtime boundary budgets pause/resume remaining computation and are not in-world scarcity, cheat prices or a hard limit on a strong fictional power. General IM1 four-foundation ordering is already narrowed by ER15: a knowledge-filtered read model can serve a useful cheat without the full time/snapshot stack. Forks can use a measured bounded synchronous path as well as workers; no mandatory technology follows from the word simulator.

F6: AD51 qualifies SB1 and AB's old third-user prerequisite and D2's two-consumer gate. Shape a useful shared seam from reasonably understood mechanisms, then use a second different case to validate/revise it under AR11; do not force three implementations or a universal all-services kernel first. AR12 preserves world differences, AR13 judges actual change surface and AR9 separates refactor from behavior. AR6 and the October17 compatibility direction supersede SB3's universal old-save-always/forward-preserve promise. A new domain still requires explicit compatibility and correct new-state roundtrip, but historical old state may be reset/dropped under its current owner. Pure validation, DTO fidelity and domain references/conservation differ; cloneability or a faster validator cannot replace semantics.

F7: Treat MC/CE/ECX/OV absolutes as source-specific proposals. Error isolation may preserve independent presentation, but a failed authoritative transaction must not continue dependent mutations on inconsistent state. Same-operation replay differs from two legitimate intended paid actions. Stable causal IDs differ from localized display sorting. UTF-16 guard counts ordinary CJK and ASCII code units alike while surrogate pairs differ; it is not a general non-Latin penalty or browser quota guarantee. Cross-engine Math has no established universal one-ulp bound. Source-map presence is not an automatic normal-page load or a blanket public-build ban. Retcon provenance preserves what happened and how holdings changed; it does not make every earned object physically immune to an authorized world mechanism. A valid extraordinary discovery route can reveal what its actual power reaches; diagnostic truth stays private until that route, rather than making every cheat omniscient or universally unable to learn a secret.

F8: The October25 D3 profile is a fresh idle route on a highly contended host, including harness clone/DOM costs, not a browser or crafting/pathfinding/generation flamegraph. The crowded run stopped without a result. Its232.9ms no-write esbuild measurement excludes Ink/prechecks/HTML/disk work. The full suite was3025/3030 with four sandbox listen failures and one absent-export input mismatch, not a passing release baseline or runner defect. Fixture gzip ratios measure size, not live encode latency or worth of compression. TS17's28-call later scan and existing replay are later snapshot evidence, not63 remaining gameplay draws or whole-game determinism. D2's100-domain registry benchmark cannot establish whole-game speedup under unmatched load. All optional pilots retain named consumer, cost and done checks; this documentation review ran none and changes no stack, save, clock, power policy, package or gameplay. Human review remains optional under AD42, separate from agent proof.
reviews.evidence: Actual entire1844-line body read in inclusive spans1–150,151–300,301–450,451–600,601–750,751–900,901–1050,1051–1200,1201–1350,1351–1490,1491–1645,1646–1785,1786–1844. Supporting architecture/rules exact matches and GAME_MCP_LIMITS1–70 inspected; no underlying runtime, installed state, source corpus or historical test rerun.
reviews.reopen: Reopen only a named current consumer, reproduced defect or measured decision uncertainty; use actual architecture, save, desktop and tool owners instead of archived blanket rules or process state.

post_record_amendments.to:
**Current use, reconciled B532 (AD32/AD36/AD39/AD41/AD42/AD51):** this palette preserves dated proposals and delivery receipts. Read [the complete-owner reconciliation](#content-reconciliation-b532-complete-palette-authority-and-evidence-scope) before using early blanket claims about clocks, third consumers, compatibility, host storage/throttling, proof or worker/commit recipes. Later selected deliveries qualify earlier absence claims; old measurements and launch instructions are history.
